verdict.rationale: Notte is built for non-interactive automation. It offers cloud browser sessions controlled programmatically, a shell CLI for agents, a Bearer-token REST API, and serverless Functions that can be invoked and scheduled anywhere. Together these cover running it headlessly for automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions setup, non-interactive CLI auth via env vars), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
